### About Me

I am a Business Engineer, and I serve as Assistant Professor of Economics (Adjunct) at the Lisbon Accounting & Business School. I am also Assistant Professor (Adjunct) at Nova School of Business and Economics and I am a member of the CEFAGE Research Center. Starting Fall 2026/2027, I will be teaching Economics in the Master of Applied Mathematics for Economics and Business, at the Department of Mathematics at the Faculty of Sciences of the University of Lisbon.

My research focuses mostly on applied economics. Previously I worked on corporate finance and applied microeconomic theory, mainly on auctions, contract theory, and matching. I have published my research in peer reviewed journals like Computational Economics and Managerial and Decision Economics. Lately I decided to go back (as a student) to the classroom to take a Master in Statistics, Applied Mathematics and Computation, at UAb.

I also have experience as economist and consultant and I am the author of an online LaTeX course.
